chat.step_compose_content: Type what you want built in plain language. Be as specific or as brief as you like — Syrus will ask for clarification if it needs more detail.
chat.step_messages_content: When Syrus proposes a Job or Epic, a confirmation card appears here. Review it, then click Confirm to start implementation — or edit your prompt and try again.
chat.step_slash_content: Type / to see available commands — like /review to audit a PR, /loop to run a task repeatedly, or /schedule to set up recurring work.
